name: US Virgin Islands
dek: A US territory. Charlotte Amalie Airport, WMO 78543, on St. Thomas.
paragraphs: The US Virgin Islands are a US territory; this is their territory sheet. The reference station is Charlotte Amalie Airport, WMO 78543, height 6 m, on St. Thomas. Christiansted on St. Croix has its own file and was not averaged in. No official driving-side, tipping, or territory emergency-number page was opened on this pass, so those lines are missing.

The highest average high in the table is 32.1 °C, in July and August. The lowest average low is 23.1 °C, in January and February. The wettest month by the precipitation column is November, at 153.8 mm, and the driest is March, at 47.2 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Charlotte Amalie Airport, WMO 78543, on St. Thomas. Christiansted on St. Croix has its own file and was not averaged in.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Charlotte Amalie Airport (78543)

season: The National Hurricane Center says the Atlantic hurricane season runs from 1 June to 30 November.
The same page says the Atlantic basin includes the North Atlantic Ocean, the Caribbean Sea, and the Gulf of Mexico.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 110 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows the United States Virgin Islands at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for the U.S. Virgin Islands, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.
water.sourceTitle: CDC Travelers' Health, the U.S. Virgin Islands

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the US Dollar, code USD, for the Virgin Islands (U.S.).

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives the Virgin Islands (US) one row, America/St_Thomas. zone1970.tab lists that zone on a row named America/Puerto_Rico, which it shares with a long list of other Caribbean and Atlantic places. The backward file links America/St_Thomas, and the older name America/Virgin, to America/Puerto_Rico. The sheet prints the zone.tab name.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: CBP's page for international visitors. It applies to travelers arriving from outside the United States, including arrivals in the US Virgin Islands. We do not restate a visa rule.
